claim_boundary: Engineering completion only. Human character/style review and macOS are not executed; neither full NS-06 nor full NS-08 PASS is permitted.

before.reason: Current official-main parent runtime and Web client before Task #77 natural-default changes.

after.reason: Same serving/native runtime; collapsed nonessential developer controls, natural three-slot I2V default, 512-token nontruncating storyboard budget, and lossless default JSON export/replay.

common_conditions.reference_description: Frozen 512x512 hand-drawn rain-cafe protagonist reference; actual bytes are external and not committed.
common_conditions.spoken_prompt_format: 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV generated once with local Flite slt; physical microphone NOT_RUN

natural_input.canonical_chinese: 做 3 个镜头的短片分镜：镜头 1 主角推开雨夜咖啡馆门，镜头 2 坐窗边看表，镜头 3 转身微笑，配旁白
natural_input.frozen_english_audio_text: Make a three shot short film storyboard. Shot 1: the protagonist pushes open the door of a rainy nighttime cafe. Shot 2: the protagonist sits by the window and checks their watch. Shot 3: the protagonist turns and smiles. Add narration.
allowed_user_actions: click Animate on each generated keyframe
click Revise and supply natural direction
forbidden_user_actions: edit request JSON or sampling/seed fields

asr_prompt_gate.rule: Evaluate only the actual final ASR text. Missing terms remain failures; no post-hoc aliases.

hard_thresholds.ns06_human_character_style_consistency: NOT_RUN; NS-06 full hard gate remains NOT_MET
hard_thresholds.ns08_macos_and_human_walkthrough: NOT_RUN; NS-08 full hard gate remains NOT_RUN

paired_decision_rule.required_after_improvement: After must preserve all NS-06 engineering counts and improve NS-08 default export/import from metadata-only to exact raw media/history restoration.
paired_decision_rule.regression_rule: Any After reduction in script/keyframe/I2V/narration counts, source binding, cancellation cleanup, or terminal integrity is NOT_PROMOTED and leaves North-Star scores unchanged.
paired_decision_rule.before_missing_features: Record actual Before failures; never backport candidate features or substitute deterministic fixtures.
paired_decision_rule.human_gate_rule: Even a paired engineering improvement cannot produce full NS-06/NS-08 PASS while the human/macOS checks are NOT_RUN.

evidence_rule: Preserve raw requests, SSE, media, ASR text, browser actions, console/audio instrumentation, screenshots, logs, source/binary/model/config identities, and a self-excluded external manifest outside Git. Commit only compact counts, thresholds, outcomes, and hashes.
